scope: CPU analytical FK only, no simulator execution or modified control.
interpretation_limits: Offsets before first wrist/pad range crossing establish temporal precedence only. Normal loads and unobserved contacts are not excluded.
Tracking lag is a physical response, not by itself a controller defect. Measured-base counterfactual targets have not been executed.
Exact remote model byte identity UNKNOWN; analytical geometry is numerically validated at all recorded states.
No comparison to training command-based targets is available in this analysis.
